headline: Common Mistakes to Avoid When Calling a Weekend Plumber
articleBody:
When you're facing a plumbing issue over the weekend in Las Vegas, it's easy to make a few common missteps that can complicate things. But with a little foresight, you can avoid unnecessary stress and expense. Here are a few things to watch out for:

- [ ] Assuming weekend availability means 24-hour emergency coverage — While many plumbers offer weekend hours, not all operate 24/7. Always confirm if your issue warrants an emergency call or if it can wait for standard weekend service.
- [ ] Failing to ask about weekend or holiday surcharges — Weekend rates often differ from weekday rates. Make sure to clarify the pricing structure, including diagnostic fees, before the plumber is dispatched.
- [ ] Not confirming the appointment window — Don't just assume they'll show up immediately. Get a realistic estimate of their arrival time so you're not left guessing or waiting unnecessarily.
- [ ] Leaving valuables or furniture in the affected area — Clear the space around the leak or fixture. This protects your belongings and provides the plumber with unobstructed access to the problem.
- [ ] Using chemical drain products before the plumber arrives without reporting them — Chemical drain cleaners can sometimes worsen a clog or create a hazardous situation for the plumber. Always mention if you've used any. Your plumber needs to know this for their safety and to assess the best repair method.

How to use this checklist: Go through these points before you pick up the phone for a weekend plumbing issue.
